critical_findings.title: The two dynamic candidate files changed before the independent review established the delegated exact-candidate identity
critical_findings.evidence: Both observed SHA-256 values differed from the hashes in the review request. The reviewer therefore stopped before semantic review and did not run the candidate tests against the disappeared delegated bytes.
critical_findings.required_fix: Stop all candidate writers, freeze a new successor identity over the final observed bytes plus this FAIL record, verify that no prior expected receipt exists, and assign a new independent reviewer.
